results.title: Nagaon Bypolls: Assam Congress to Hold Meetings Ahead of Finalising Candidate
results.description: Guwahati: The Assam Pradesh Congress Committee (APCC) has stepped up preparations for the upcoming Nagaon Lok Sabha constituency bye-election, with the party set to hold a series of meetings at Rajiv Bhawan in Guwahati on Saturday to finalise its candidate panel. The consultations will be led by newly appointed Assam Congress in-charge and AICC general secretary Bhupesh Baghel , who will meet senior party leaders, legislators and organisational office-bearers as the Congress moves towards announcing its candidate for the bypoll. According to the schedule issued by the Assam Pradesh Congress Committee, Baghel will begin consultations from 10 am today at Rajiv Bhawan. He will hold separate meetings with members of the Political Affairs Committee (PAC), APCC office-bearers, MLAs, MPs and senior party leaders regarding the Nagaon Lok Sabha bye-election. The consultations are expected to culminate in the finalisation of the Congress candidate panel for the constituency. The party is also preparing to engage with other opposition parties later in the day as part of efforts to coordinate ahead of the bye-election. Baghel will hold a meeting in the evening; however, Raijor Dal, led by Akhil Gogoi, will not be a part of the talks after recently severing ties with the Congress-led opposition bloc in the state. The consultations assume significance as the Congress works to consolidate opposition support and settle its own candidate ahead of the Nagaon bypoll.
